name: Jaina's Autograph
label: Quest
description: Jaina's Autograph: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: They say that Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore is one of the greatest heroes the Alliance has ever had. When I grow up, I wanna be a hero of the Alliance too!

Do you know Jaina, friend? Could you do me a favor, please? Could you get her autograph for me? I dunno how to ask her, and she'd probably be too busy for someone like me... But you! You're an adventurer just like she is! I bet she'd give you her autograph easy!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Someday, I wanna be a hero just like Jaina... Well, a boy hero that is.

clips.title: Completion
paras: WOW! You got Lady Jaina's autograph for me! Thank you very much! And wow... She wrote a personal message on here - to me! I knew she'd be totally cool, and maybe someday I'll thank her myself... When I become a hero of the Alliance!
You're the best, friend. Thank you for being so nice to me.
